info.title: Account Information
info.description: Retrieve real-time account and transaction information for all your authorized BMO accounts without the need to switch applications.

tags.name: Account Information
tags.description: Query all information for a set of accounts provided in the payload

parameters.name: accountIds
parameters.description: Comma separated list of account ids

parameters.name: resultType
parameters.description: Flag to indicate if you want a lightweight array of descriptors or full account details. If set to `lightweight`, should only return the fields associated with the `AccountDescriptor` entity. This field is not required, but defaults to lightweight

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Opaque cursor used by the provider to send the next set of records

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of elements that the consumer wishes to receive - Providers should implement reasonable defaults and maximum

action.description: HTTP Method to use for the request (Suggested)

types.description: Content-types that can be used in the Accept header.

nextOffset.description: Opaque identified. Does not need to be numeric or have any specific pattern. Implementation specific.

prevOffset.description: Opaque identified. Does not need to be numeric or have any specific pattern. Implementation specific.

PaginatedArray.description: To be used as a mixin using "allOf"

Account.title: Account Entity
Account.description: An account object with limited details returned in the search for accounts operation.

accountId.description: Long-term persistent identity of the account. Not an account number. This identity must be unique to the owning institution.

accountNumber.description: Return masked account based on request.

hostAccountName.description: Name given by the user. Used in UIs to assist in account selection

AccountDetails.title: Account Entity
AccountDetails.description: An account object that adds additional detail parameters to the basic Accounts object, this is used in Get an Account operation.

routingTransitNumber.description: Routing transit number (RTN) associated with account number at owning institution.

Accounts.description: An instance of the getAccounts types with limited details.

GetAccount.description: An instance of an account with full details.

GetAccounts.title: Accounts Entity
GetAccounts.description: An optionally paginated array of accounts.

Currency.title: Currency Entity

currencyRate.description: Currency rate between original and converted currency

Currency.description: Currency information if it is different from Account entity

couponRate.description: Bond coupon rate for next closest call date

couponDate.description: Maturity date for next coupon. YYYY-MM-DD.

DepositAccount.title: DepositAccount Entity
DepositAccount.description: Deposit accounts will have following fields in FiAttributes - PreviousBalance, OpenDate, StatementName, 1DayFloat, 2orMoreDaysFloat, AccruedInterestMTD, ProjectedInterested, InterestPaidPreviousMonth

availableBalance.description: Balance of funds available for use

DepositTransaction.title: DepositTransaction Entity
DepositTransaction.description: Deposit Transaction will have following fields in FiAttributes - Posted, Pending, ValueDate

Error.title: Error Entity

code.description: Long term persistent identifier which can be used to trace error condition back to log information

message.description: End user displayable information which might help the customer diagnose an error

Error.description: An error entity which can be used at the API level for error responses or at the account level to indicate a problem specific to a particular account.

value.description: Value of attribute. All date fields will be of the string format YYYY-MM-DD.

percent.description: Percentage of asset class that falls under this asset

currentValue.description: Total current value of all investments

balanceList.description: Balance List. Name value pair aggregate.

balanceDate.description: Date as of this balance. YYYY-MM-DD.

InvestmentTransaction.title: InvestmentTransaction Entity
InvestmentTransaction.description: Investment Transaction will have following fields in FiAttributes - Posted, IssueDate, MaturityDate, InterestRate, OriginalAmount, CurrentValue, Disposition

shares.description: Required for stock, mutual funds. Number of shares (with decimals). Negative numbers indicate securities are being removed from the account.

markup.description: Portion of unit price that is attributed to the dealer markup

fractionalCash.description: Cash for fractional units (used for stock splits)

subAccountSec.description: Sub-account security Type - CASH, MARGIN, SHORT and OTHERS

subAccountFund.description: From which account money came in - CASH, MARGIN, SHORT and OTHERS

loanId.description: For 401k accounts only. This indicates the transaction was due to a loan or a loan repayment.

loanPrincipal.description: How much loan pre‐payment is principal

loanInterest.description: How much loan pre‐payment is interest

payrollDate.description: The date for the 401k transaction was obtained in payroll. YYYY-MM-DD.

priorYearContrib.description: Indicates this buy was made using prior year's contribution.

penalty.description: Indicates amount withheld due to a penalty

unitPrice.description: Price per commonly-quoted unit. Does not include markup/markdown, unitprice. Share price for stocks, mutual funds, and others. Percentage of par for bonds. Per share (not contract) for options.

units.description: For security‐based actions other than stock splits, quantity. Shares for stocks, mutual funds, and others. Face value for bonds. Contracts for options.

LoanAccount.title: LoanAccount Entity
LoanAccount.description: Loan accounts will have following fields in FiAttributes - BorrowerName, FacilityName, OutstandingBal, OutstandingBalLoanCurr, MaturityDate

LocAccount.title: LocAccount Entity
LocAccount.description: Loc accounts will have following fields in FiAttributes - StatementBalance

nextPaymentDate.description: Due date of next payment. YYYY-MM-DD.

LocTransaction.title: LocTransaction Entity
LocTransaction.description: Line of Credit Transaction will have following fields in FiAttributes - Posted, Pending, ValueDate

unitsStreet.description: Units in the FI's street name, positive quantity

unitsUser.description: Units in user's name directly, positive  quantity

yield.description: Current yield reported as portion of the fund's assets

yieldAsOfDate.description: As-of date for yield value. YYYY-MM-DD.

units.description: Number of units (shares or bonds etc)

principalAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to principal

interestAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to interest

insuranceAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to life/health/accident insurance on the loan

escrowAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to escrow

pmiAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to PMI

feesAmount.description: The amount of payment applied to fees

unitsStreet.description: Units in the FI's street name, positive quantity

unitsUser.description: Units in user's name directly, positive  quantity

availableBalance.description: Balance of funds available for use

checks.description: Whether or not checks can be written on the account

costBasis.description: Total amount of money spent acquiring this lot including any fees or commission expenses incurred

transactionId.description: Long term persistent identity of the transaction (unique to account)

referenceTransactionId.description: For reverse postings, the identity of the transaction being reversed. For the correction transaction, the identity of the reversing post. For credit card posting transactions, the identity of the authorization transaction.

postedTimestamp.description: The date and time that the transaction was posted to the account. If not provided then TransactionTimestamp can be used as PostedTimeStamp. YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS.S

transactionTimestamp.description: The date and time that the transaction was added to the server backend systems. YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS.S

category.description: Transaction category, preferably MCC or SIC.

amount.description: The amount of money in the account currency

image.description: Array of Image Identifiers (unique to Transaction) used to retrieve Images of check or transaction receipt

BAILevel.description: BAI level information for the transaction

BAICode.description: BAI code information for the transaction

BAIName.description: BAI name related to the transaction

fundType.description: Fund type corresponding to the transaction

transactions.description: An array of transactions with entity types dependent on the account type (deposit, investment, loan, or line of credit)

BalanceType.title: BalanceType
BalanceType.description: ASSET (positive transaction amount increases balance) LIABILITY (positive transaction amount decreases balance)

CallType.title: CallType
CallType.description: Type of next call (CALL, PUT, PREFUND, MATURITY)

CompoundingPeriod.title: CompoundingPeriod
CompoundingPeriod.description: DAILY, WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, SEMIMONTHLY, MONTHLY, SEMIANNUALLY, ANNUALLY

CouponMatureFrequency.title: CouponMatureFrequency
CouponMatureFrequency.description: When coupons mature (MONTHLY, QUARTERLY,  SEMIANNUAL, ANNUAL, OTHER)

DebtClass.title: DebtClass
DebtClass.description: Classification of debt (TREASURY, MUNICIPAL, CORPORATE, OTHER)

DepositTransactionType.title: DepositTransaction Type
DepositTransactionType.description: CHECK, WITHDRAWAL, TRANSFER, POSDEBIT, ATMWITHDRAWAL. BILLPAYMENT, FEE, DEPOSIT, ADJUSTMENT, INTEREST, DIVIDEND, DIRECTDEPOSIT, ATMDEPOSIT, POSCREDIT

IncomeType.title: IncomeType
IncomeType.description: Type of investment income - CGLONG (capital gains-long term), CGSHORT (capital gains-short term), MISC

Inv401kSourceType.title: Inv401kSourceType
Inv401kSourceType.description: Source of money. PRETAX, AFTERTAX, MATCH, PROFITSHARING, ROLLOVER OTHERVEST, OTHERNONVEST

InvestmentTransactionType.title: InvestmentTransactionType
InvestmentTransactionType.description: PURCHASED, SOLD, PURCHASEDTOCOVER, ADJUSTMENT, PURCHASETOOPEN, PURCHASETOCLOSE, SOLDTOOPEN, SOLDTOCLOSE, INTEREST, MARGININTEREST, REINVESTOFINCOME, RETURNOFCAPITAL, TRANSFER, CONTRIBUTION, FEE, OPTIONEXERCISE, OPTIONEXPIRATION, DIVIDEND, DIVIDENDREINVEST, SPLIT, CLOSURE, INCOME, EXPENSE, CLOSUREOPT, INVEXPENSE, JRNLSEC, JRNLFUND, OTHER, DIV, SRVCHG, DEP, DEPOSIT, ATM, POS, XFER, CHECK, PAYMENT, CASH, DIRECTDEP, DIRECTDEBIT, REPEATPMT

Iso4217Code.title: Iso4217Code
Iso4217Code.description: The ISO 4217 code of the foreign currency

LoanPaymentFrequency.title: LoanPaymentFrequency
LoanPaymentFrequency.description: WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, TWICEMONTHLY, MONTHLY, FOURWEEKS, BIMONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMIANNUALLY, ANNUALLY, OTHER

LocTransactionType.title: LocTransactionType
LocTransactionType.description: CHECK, WITHDRAWAL, PAYMENT, FEE, ADJUSTMENT, INTEREST

OrderDuration.title: OrderDuration
OrderDuration.description: This order is good for DAY, GOODTILLCANCEL, IMMEDIATE

PaymentFrequency.title: PaymentFrequency
PaymentFrequency.description: DAILY, WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, SEMIMONTHLY, MONTHLY, SEMIANNUALLY, ANNUALLY

TransactionReason.title: TransactionReason
TransactionReason.description: Reason for this transaction; CALL (the debt was called), SELL (the debt was sold), MATURITY (the debt reached maturity)
